template.name: sequentia/mint-limiter

params.label: Reissuance token held by the covenant
params.name: TOKEN

params.label: Cold key, which applies and lifts the brake and recovers
params.name: COLD_KEY

params.label: Most minted in one window, in the asset
params.name: ALLOWANCE

params.label: Time the brake holds before recovery, in units of 512 seconds
params.name: RECOVERY_DELAY

paths.effect: Reissues ASSET on input 0, explicitly, and re-creates the covenant at output 0 with the token's whole amount. The coin must be at least two blocks old, by a relative lock in blocks on its own input, and the brake off. Its age is added to ELAPSED; once ELAPSED reaches WINDOW the mint opens a new window and MINTED restarts from its amount and ELAPSED from zero, else MINTED grows by its amount. MINTED may not exceed ALLOWANCE. Signed by OPERATOR_KEY over the whole transaction.
paths.name: mint

paths.effect: Applies the brake: re-creates the covenant at output 0 with ARMED set to 1, MINTED and ELAPSED unchanged and no issuance on input 0, after which no mint is possible. ARM_SIG is COLD_KEY's BIP340 signature over SHA256(T || T || genesis hash || leaf hash || ASSET || TOKEN || OPERATOR_KEY || COLD_KEY || WINDOW || ALLOWANCE || RECOVERY_DELAY), with T = SHA256("sequentia/mint-limiter/arm"); it names no coin and no state, so one signature made in advance applies to whichever coin is current.
paths.name: arm
paths.who: anyone holding COLD_KEY's signature over the arm message

paths.effect: Lifts the brake: re-creates the covenant at output 0 with ARMED set to 0, MINTED and ELAPSED unchanged and no issuance on input 0. Signed by COLD_KEY over the whole transaction.
paths.name: disarm

paths.effect: Spends the token into any transaction COLD_KEY signs, once the brake has held for RECOVERY_DELAY units of 512 seconds, a BIP68 relative lock on input 0. Only COLD_KEY can spend a braked coin, so nothing restarts that delay.
paths.name: recover

slots.label: Blocks of the current window behind this coin
slots.name: ELAPSED

slots.label: 1 while the brake is on, else 0
slots.name: ARMED

template.summary: Holds an asset's reissuance token: the operator mints at most an allowance per window of blocks, and a cold key can apply a brake that stops every mint, lift it, or take the token once the brake has held for a long delay.

mint.transaction: the covenant as input 0 reissuing within a window, one wallet coin paying the fee in an issued asset; the successor, the minted output, the change and the fee

mint_opening_a_window.transaction: the same, a mint that ends the window and opens the next

arm.transaction: the covenant as input 0 and a third party's fee coin; the braked successor, the change and the fee

disarm.transaction: the covenant as input 0 and a fee coin; the successor with the brake off, the change and the fee

recover.transaction: the braked covenant as input 0 and a fee coin; the whole token to one output, the change and the fee
